title: Job, Chapter 28 (Leningrad Codex)
source: Leningrad Codex folios (Internet Archive, WSRP photographs) + tanach.us LC folio index + UXLC Hebrew + KJV
description: Job 28 on folios 404v, 405r of the Leningrad Codex (1008 AD), the oldest complete Hebrew Bible. Hebrew from the UXLC transcription of this manuscript; English KJV.
introduction:
Job chapter 28 from the Leningrad Codex (Codex Leningradensis, National Library of Russia, Firkovich EBP. I B 19a), copied in Cairo by Samuel ben Jacob and dated 1008/1009 AD, the oldest complete manuscript of the Hebrew Bible and the base text of the Biblia Hebraica editions. This chapter stands on folios 404v, 405r.

This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library:

  1. Manuscript scan: the specific folio side(s) carrying each section's verses, from the full-colour West Semitic Research Project photographs of the codex as redistributed on Internet Archive (item Leningrad_Codex_Color_Images, marked Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0). Folio-to-verse ranges come from the tanach.us LC folio index, which was derived from the West Semitic Research Project's published index; each section links only to the page(s) whose recorded verse range contains its verses.
  2. Original text: the verbatim Hebrew of this manuscript in the Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC 2.5 build 27.6, tanach.us), a transcription of Firkovich B 19a with vowels and cantillation, released without restriction on the biblical text.
  3. English translation: the King James Version (1611, public domain), retrieved verbatim from bolls.life (KJV text, Strong's numbers stripped).
translator_notes: פ and ס mark the open and closed paragraph breaks visible as gaps in the manuscript columns.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃ <sup>2</sup>בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃ <sup>3</sup>קֵ֤ץ ׀ שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל־תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃ <sup>4</sup>פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל ׀ מֵֽעִם־גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי־רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ׃ <sup>5</sup>אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא־לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ־אֵֽשׁ׃ <sup>6</sup>מְקוֹם־סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ׃ <sup>7</sup>נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא־יְדָ֣עוֹ עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה׃ <sup>8</sup>לֹֽא־הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ בְנֵי־שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא־עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל׃
translation.text: <sup>1</sup>Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it. <sup>2</sup>Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone. <sup>3</sup>He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death. <sup>4</sup>The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men. <sup>5</sup>As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire. <sup>6</sup>The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold. <sup>7</sup>There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen: <sup>8</sup>The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

translation.original_text: <sup>9</sup>בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים׃ <sup>10</sup>בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכָל־יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽוֹ׃ <sup>11</sup>מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר׃ פ <sup>12</sup>וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃ <sup>13</sup>לֹא־יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הֽ͏ַחַיִּֽים׃ <sup>14</sup>תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי־הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי׃ <sup>15</sup>לֹא־יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ׃ <sup>16</sup>לֹֽא־תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר׃
translation.text: <sup>9</sup>He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots. <sup>10</sup>He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing. <sup>11</sup>He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light. <sup>12</sup>But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding? <sup>13</sup>Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living. <sup>14</sup>The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me. <sup>15</sup>It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof. <sup>16</sup>It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

translation.original_text: <sup>17</sup>לֹא־יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי־פָֽז׃ <sup>18</sup>רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃ <sup>19</sup>לֹֽא־יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה׃ פ <sup>20</sup>וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃ <sup>21</sup>וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל־חָ֑י וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה׃ <sup>22</sup>אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ׃ <sup>23</sup>אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת־מְקוֹמָֽהּ׃ <sup>24</sup>כִּי־ה֭וּא לִקְצוֹת־הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה׃
translation.text: <sup>17</sup>The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold. <sup>18</sup>No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies. <sup>19</sup>The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold. <sup>20</sup>Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding? <sup>21</sup>Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air. <sup>22</sup>Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears. <sup>23</sup>God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof. <sup>24</sup>For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

translation.original_text: <sup>25</sup>לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה׃ <sup>26</sup>בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃ <sup>27</sup>אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם־חֲקָרָֽהּ׃ <sup>28</sup>וַיֹּ֤אמֶר ׀ לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה׃ ס
translation.text: <sup>25</sup>To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure. <sup>26</sup>When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder: <sup>27</sup>Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out. <sup>28</sup>And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
